title: First interpreter step
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $p$ be one of its input-head positions, and let $T$ be a Boolean table word. One step of the stopped table interpreter from its entry configuration with input head at $p$ and table $T$ yields the evaluation configuration based on the inactive base data at $p$, in control phase “rewind table” with its initial flag set, table cursor $|T|-1$, state tape encoding state $0$, and state cursor $1$.
replaced:
The first step of the stopped table interpreter from its entry configuration
installs the two permanent markers (the state-tape origin marker and the
virtual-input boundary marker) and enters the unconditional table rewind with
the table cursor on the last table cell.
